entities.summary: Aldo Luigi Mario Castellani, Marchese di Chisimajo, KCMG was an Italian pathologist and microbiologist. He is best remembered as discoverer of the etiology of sleeping sickness and Yaws (1905), and as a pioneer in the development and use of combined vaccines.
